From 34fbf48cf3b410d2a6e8c586fa952a36331ca5ba Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jason Gunthorpe <jgg@nvidia.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 13:17:42 -0300
Subject: [PATCH] RDMA/ocrdma: Don't NULL deref uctx on errors in
 ocrdma_copy_pd_uresp()

Sashiko points out that pd->uctx isn't initialized until late in the
function so all these error flow references are NULL and will crash. Use
the uctx that isn't NULL.

Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Fixes: fe2caefcdf58 ("RDMA/ocrdma: Add driver for Emulex OneConnect IBoE RDMA adapter")
Link: https://sashiko.dev/#/patchset/0-v1-e911b76a94d1%2B65d95-rdma_udata_rep_jgg%40nvidia.com?part=4
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/r/9-v1-41f3135e5565+9d2-rdma_ai_fixes1_jgg@nvidia.com
Signed-off-by: Jason Gunthorpe <jgg@nvidia.com>

diff --git a/drivers/infiniband/hw/ocrdma/ocrdma_verbs.c b/drivers/infiniband/hw/ocrdma/ocrdma_verbs.c
index 463c9a5703fc..a88cc5d84af8 100644
--- a/drivers/infiniband/hw/ocrdma/ocrdma_verbs.c
+++ b/drivers/infiniband/hw/ocrdma/ocrdma_verbs.c
@@ -620,9 +620,9 @@ static int ocrdma_copy_pd_uresp(struct ocrdma_dev *dev, struct ocrdma_pd *pd,
 
 ucopy_err:
 	if (pd->dpp_enabled)
-		ocrdma_del_mmap(pd->uctx, dpp_page_addr, PAGE_SIZE);
+		ocrdma_del_mmap(uctx, dpp_page_addr, PAGE_SIZE);
 dpp_map_err:
-	ocrdma_del_mmap(pd->uctx, db_page_addr, db_page_size);
+	ocrdma_del_mmap(uctx, db_page_addr, db_page_size);
 	return status;
 }
 
-- 
2.34.1

The patch fixes a NULL pointer dereference bug in the `ocrdma_copy_pd_uresp()` function within the RDMA/ocrdma driver. The issue occurs because `pd->uctx` is only initialized later in the function, but the error handling paths (`ucopy_err` and `dpp_map_err`) incorrectly referenced `pd->uctx`, which is still `NULL` at that point. The fix replaces `pd->uctx` with the already available `uctx` pointer passed as a parameter to the function.

**Modifications in each file:**

- **`drivers/infiniband/hw/ocrdma/ocrdma_verbs.c`**:
  - **Line 623** (under `ucopy_err` label): Changed `pd->uctx` to `uctx`.
  - **Line 625** (under `dpp_map_err` label): Changed `pd->uctx` to `uctx`.

**Relationships between modifications:**

Both changes are within the same error handling block of the same function and address the same root cause: using the correct pointer `uctx` instead of the uninitialized `pd->uctx`. The two error labels are sequential (first `ucopy_err`, then `dpp_map_err`), and the fix ensures that both cleanup paths use the valid `uctx` pointer to avoid a NULL dereference crash.

Root cause:
In `ocrdma_copy_pd_uresp()`, the error handling paths (`ucopy_err` and `dpp_map_err`) use `pd->uctx`, but this pointer is not initialized until later in the function, causing a NULL pointer dereference when an error occurs before that initialization.

Code statements information:
The code statements that lead to the bug are:
ocrdma_del_mmap(pd->uctx, dpp_page_addr, PAGE_SIZE);
ocrdma_del_mmap(pd->uctx, db_page_addr, db_page_size);
Reason:
These error path statements use pd->uctx, which is not initialized until later in the function (after `pd->uctx = uctx;`). Since pd->uctx is NULL before that assignment, dereferencing it in `ocrdma_del_mmap` causes a NULL pointer dereference.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
ocrdma_del_mmap(uctx, dpp_page_addr, PAGE_SIZE);
ocrdma_del_mmap(uctx, db_page_addr, db_page_size);
Reason:
The local variable `uctx` is initialized early in the function from `udata` and is always valid. Replacing `pd->uctx` with `uctx` avoids the NULL pointer dereference because `uctx` is already set and points to the correct ucontext.


Now, determine whether the provided code snippet is buggy:
	if (pd->dpp_enabled)
		ocrdma_del_mmap(pd->uctx, dpp_page_addr, PAGE_SIZE);
dpp_map_err:
	ocrdma_del_mmap(pd->uctx, db_page_addr, db_page_size);
	return status;
}
